ण: ण ṇ The nasal of the lingual class.
ण (णः) 1. m. Knowledge; certainty; Shiva; Vindudeva; ornament; a water or summer house; bad man; sound of negation; gift.
णक्ष्: णक्ष् नक्षति प्रणक्षति 1. a. To go.
णट्: णट् नटति 1. a. To dance; to act.
णद्: णद् नदति 1. a. To sound inarti-culately as a bell, river or beast.
णद् (क) नादयति To tell; to shine.
णभ्: णभ् (ञ, य, ग) नभति, ते 1. c. नभ्यति 4. a. नभ्नाति 9. a. To kill, to die.
णम्: णम् (औ) नमति 1. a. To salute with reverence or respect. With अव, आ or सं to bend; with उत् to erect; with प्र to bow or salute.
णय: णय (ञ) नयति, ते 1. c. To go, to ap-proach; to preserve; to defend.
णल्: णल् नलति 1. a. To smell; to bind.
णश्: णश् (य) नश्यति 4. a. To disappear; to perish, to be annihilated.
णस्: णस् (ञ) नसति 1. c. To be crooked, li-terally or metaphorically, to bend.
णह्: णह् (ञ, औ) नह्यति, ते 4. c. To bind or tie. With सं to put on armour.
णास्: णास् (ङ, ऋ) नासते 1. d. To sound.
णिज्: णिज् (ल, इ) निंक्ते 2. d. To cleanse with; (लि, औ, इर) नेनेक्ति to che-rish; नेनिक्ते 3. c. To purify.
णिद्: णिद् (इ) निन्दति 1. a. To abuse, to revile. (ऋ) नेदति, ते 1. c. Idem.
णिल्: णिल् नेलति 1. a. To misunderstand; to be thick, impenetrable.
णिश्: णिश् नेशति 1. a. To meditate pro-foundly, or abstractedly.
णिष्: णिष् नेषति a. To meditate closely.
णिस्: णिस् (ल, इ-ङ) निंस्ते 2. d. To kiss.
णी: णी नयति, ते 1. c. To conduct, lead to, get. With अनु to intreat, to assimilate, to favour; with अप to remove, attract; with अभि to indicate by signs, be kind to; with आ to bring; with उत् to raise up; with उप to approach; with दुर् to behave ill; with निर् to get, to ascertain; with परि to marry; with प्र to love; with वि to remove to a distance, be hum-ble; with सु to be polite; with सं to collect or assemble; with वि and अप to disperse; with वि and निर to decide by law; with सं and अनु to intreat; with सं and आ to collect, to assemble.
णील्: णील् नीलति 1. a. To be blue.
णीव्: णीव् नीवति 1. a. To be large.
णु: णु (ल) नौति नुवति 2. a. To praise. With आ to utter a cry of regret.
णुद्: णुद् (श-औ) नुदति 6. a. To cast, to command. With अप to remove; with निर् to throw out; to con-fess; with प्र to follow; with वि to be happy; with सं to drive.
णेद्: णेद् (ऋ) नेदति, ते 1. c. To censure; to approach.
णेष्: णेष् (ङ, ऋ) नेषति 1. d. To go, approach.
